source_timeline.report: Owner says cannot get screen/BIOS display, front power LED lit; yellow storage activity LED also lit
Community helper suggests isolating NVMe/SATA storage as a diagnostic, not confirmed fault
Owner later says can boot/log in via remote desktop but HDMI screen still does not work
Intel support refers NUC support to ASUS; final HDMI repair not demonstrated

claim_boundary: Independent real-case public discussion, not physical lab data. Never substitute owner reports for measured target board data or falsely claim HDMI repair.
